title: a layer rule broken, or a new import cycle

explain.what: An import crosses a layer boundary (engine/lib may not import engine/dash or engine/bin), or the branch adds a new import cycle.
explain.why: The layers keep the core library usable without the dashboard or the CLI. A cycle makes the load order fragile and the modules impossible to change one at a time.
explain.fix: Move the shared code down into engine/lib, or pass the value in as a parameter, so that the import goes one way only.

base.engine/bin/src/lib.rs: pub fn twice(n: u8) -> u8 { n * 2 }

head.engine/lib/a.mjs:
import { x } from '../bin/x.mjs';
export const a = x;
head.engine/lib/pa.py:
from engine.bin import tool
A = tool.X
head.engine/lib/ta.ts:
import { y } from '../bin/y.ts';
export const ta = y;
head.engine/bin/src/lib.rs: pub fn twice(n: u8) -> u8 { n * 2 }
head.engine/lib/src/lib.rs:
use tool::twice;
pub fn four() -> u8 { twice(2) }

base.engine/lib/a.mjs:
import { b } from './b.mjs';
export const a = () => b;
base.engine/lib/b.mjs:
import { a } from './a.mjs';
export const b = () => a;

head.engine/lib/a.mjs:
import { b } from './b.mjs';
export const a = () => b();
head.engine/lib/b.mjs:
import { a } from './a.mjs';
export const b = () => a;
head.engine/bin/x.mjs:
import { a } from '../lib/a.mjs';
export const x = a;
head.engine/bin/y.ts:
import { tb } from '../lib/tb.ts';
export const y = tb;
head.engine/bin/src/lib.rs:
use base_core::four;
pub fn eight() -> u8 { four() * 2 }
